resources.string: Cycles through the spectrum very slowly so it won\'t make you dizzy.
I don\'t have my model downloaded yet. Go to Settings › AI and tap “Download model” (one time, on Wi‑Fi).
To chat, first accept the AI terms.
The chat uses a small language model that you download in Settings › AI (Gemma 4 E2B). It runs on your phone with Google\'s LiteRT-LM. It is downloaded once, from Hugging Face.
In local mode the model runs on your phone without internet: your messages never leave the device. Only the model download uses internet. MusicFlame does not receive your conversations.

It is a small model and can be wrong or make things up (years, BPM, albums, lyrics). Double-check important information. Don\'t use it for medical, legal, financial or safety decisions. Provided “as is”, without warranties.
It uses about 2.6 GB of storage and quite a bit of RAM while answering. It can take several seconds, warm up the phone and use battery. You can delete the model anytime in Settings › AI.

Gemma 4 and LiteRT-LM are distributed under the Apache 2.0 license, which allows use and redistribution with a license notice (see Settings › Third-party licenses). MusicFlame is an independent project: it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
Local model, Apache 2.0 license. One-time download of %1$s; works offline.
Downloading on Wi‑Fi is recommended. If it is interrupted, it resumes where it left off.
Model ready (%1$s MB on your phone)
This frees the space. You can download it again anytime.
Pick a model. You can only have one downloaded at a time: to switch, delete the current one and download another.
Delete the downloaded model to use this one.

The recommended one: the smartest and, with MTP acceleration, fast on phones with a decent GPU. Large download (≈2.6 GB); 6 GB of RAM or more recommended. If you downloaded it before May 2026, delete it and download it again to enable the acceleration.
Commands need the online AI (Groq). Turn it on in Settings › AI.
